packet.title: Android library (implementation; assemble here, devices: owner)

item.p: bindings/kotlin/android/: a Gradle project, AGP with externalNativeBuild running the top-level CMake with SXML_BUILD_TESTS=OFF, SXML_BUILD_APPS=OFF and SXML_BUILD_KOTLIN=ON for the four ABIs;
the shared Kotlin sources by srcDir, consumer ProGuard rules (keep the native methods and the request classes);
androidTest, which is the same test sources run by an instrumentation runner;
the AAR holds the four .so files and allkeys.txt;
the size report is below the budget, proposed () at 9,000,000 bytes stripped and 2,400,000 gzipped for libsxml_kotlin.so on arm64-v8a (the probe's whole libsxml.so: 7,693,024 and 1,910,096).

body.p: Owner: connectedAndroidTest on an x86_64 emulator at API 24 and 35 and on one arm64 device.
